question:
Study the given diagram carefully and answer the question. The numbers in different sections indicate the number of things.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/b451dad7e1d170c09c2ba62bfbd7d3b7c3f09a4f42ffc40abf81c4eb7afd3a23.png] 

How many such trees are there that are also plants but NEITHER herbs NOR bushes?
solution:
According to the given Venn diagram:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7b7acbe8dc8ff4f06334f077ed0bd2a03c25b0c439b863b11ba8dbb2841c5220.png] 

The shaded region represents the trees are there that are also plants but neither herbs nor bushes.

So, the trees are there that are also plants but neither herbs nor bushes = **'8'**

Hence, the correct answer is "Option 3".
